This is a steel mobile workstation with drawers, a wood tabletop, a pegboard and an overhead hutch. It is classified as furniture, and the choice is between heading 9403 (other furniture) and a more specific subheading.

The relevant subheadings are:
- 9403.10 covers metal furniture of a kind used in offices.
- 9403.20 covers other metal furniture.

The unit is a garage or workshop workstation, not office furniture, so 9403.20 applies. Its subheading 9403.20.00 breaks down into statistical lines:
- 9403.20.0010: Cabinets, other than office-type (later versions)
- 9403.20.0020: Other
- 9403.20.0030: Other

I am not certain of the exact statistical suffix. Current HTS has 9403.20.0010 (luggage lockers), 9403.20.0020 (other: bed frames), and 9403.20.0030 (other). The 9403.20.00 breakout also includes 9403.20.0050 for tool chests, which I have not verified. A CBP ruling on similar garage cabinets (the Gladiator workstation) classified them in 9403.20.0090. The more recent HTS structure has 9403.20.0010 (Household-type, other), 9403.20.0020 (Other), 9403.20.0030 (Other?), 9403.20.0050 (Other?), and 9403.20.0090 (Other). I chose 9403.20.0090 as the general "other" line.
